newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Ciller postones visit to Jordan.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Ciller postones visit to Jordan.

text.p: Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller postponed a visit to Jordan for a second time amid a crisis over Baghdad's interference in Kurdish fighting in northern Iraq, a foreign ministry statement said on Monday.
The statement said Ciller had prefered "not to leave Ankara at this stage, due to the developments taking place in the region." It did not say what date the visit had been put off to.

Ciller's visit to Amman had already been postponed from September 3 to September 17 after Saddam Hussein's forces attacked to dislodge one Kurdish faction from the main northern Iraqi city of Arbil and install another more favourable to Baghdad.
The U.S. launched cruise missile attacks on Iraqi targets in retaliation.

Both Ankara and Amman allow U.S. planes to patrol no-fly zones over northern Iraq from their own territory. Jordan is one of the few countries in the Arab world that has not criticised Turkey for its plans to set up a 10 km (six mile) deep security cordon inside northern Iraq to combat Kurdish guerrillas.
